STYLE GUIDE (apply to every asset):
Top-down 3/4 perspective pixel art for a 2D mystery/investigation game, in the readable, cozy-clean style of classic farming/life-sim pixel games, but dark and atmospheric.
Setting: an original foggy Victorian-era industrial city called Kettlegate with occult undertones: cobblestone streets, gas lamps, soot-stained brick, wrought iron, canals, chapels, secret societies, alchemical potions.
Grid: strict 16x16 pixel tiles. Overworld characters are 16x32 pixels per frame. Every pixel must align to the grid; no half pixels, no sub-pixel detail.
Pixels: crisp hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients; deliberate 2-tone checker dithering only on large surfaces or for fake transparency. 1px dark outline in deep blue-grey (around #1a1c2c, not pure black) on characters, props and icons; terrain tiles have no outline.
Palette: limited muted palette of max 32 colors, matching the existing game sprites. Desaturated slate blues, fog greys, soot browns, mossy greens, rust and brass, bone white; warm amber/yellow only for gas lamp light and candles; turquoise #6fe0d0 or deep violet reserved for occult/supernatural things. Avoid saturated primaries and pure black/white.
Lighting: flat base colors with 2-3 shade steps; light from top-left. Do not bake night darkness into sprites (the engine adds lighting).
Mood: melancholic, mysterious, slightly unsettling, never gory.
Output: transparent background (PNG with alpha) unless stated otherwise, orthographic, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no signature.
Avoid: 3D render look, painterly style, photorealism, chibi exaggeration, anime eyes, references to existing games, films or franchises.
Character sprite sheet: a thin records clerk woman with auburn red-brown hair in a bun, olive-grey dress and cardigan, half-moon spectacles, armful of files, dust on her sleeves. Exactly four rows facing down, left, right, up; four walk-cycle frames per row. Logical 16x32 pixel cells, total 64x128 pixels. All sixteen figures centered within equal cells, feet at same baseline. No margins, no gridlines. Render at integer enlargement if necessary. Use the attached sprites as strict style reference: same palette, outline color, pixel density, proportions and light direction.

Setting: an original foggy Victorian-era industrial city called Kettlegate with occult undertones: cobblestone streets, gas lamps, soot-stained brick, wrought iron, canals, chapels, secret societies, alchemical potions.
Grid: strict 16x16 pixel tiles. Overworld characters are 16x32 pixels per frame. Every pixel must align to the grid; no half pixels, no sub-pixel detail.
Pixels: crisp hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients; deliberate 2-tone checker dithering only on large surfaces or for fake transparency. 1px dark outline in deep blue-grey (around #1a1c2c, not pure black) on characters, props and icons; terrain tiles have no outline.
Palette: limited muted palette of max 32 colors, matching the existing game sprites. Desaturated slate blues, fog greys, soot browns, mossy greens, rust and brass, bone white; warm amber/yellow only for gas lamp light and candles; turquoise #6fe0d0 or deep violet reserved for occult/supernatural things. Avoid saturated primaries and pure black/white.
Lighting: flat base colors with 2-3 shade steps; light from top-left. Do not bake night darkness into sprites (the engine adds lighting).
Mood: melancholic, mysterious, slightly unsettling, never gory.
Output: transparent background (PNG with alpha) unless stated otherwise, orthographic, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no signature.
Avoid: 3D render look, painterly style, photorealism, chibi exaggeration, anime eyes, references to existing games, films or franchises.

Setting: an original foggy Victorian-era industrial city called Kettlegate with occult undertones: cobblestone streets, gas lamps, soot-stained brick, wrought iron, canals, chapels, secret societies, alchemical potions.
Grid: strict 16x16 pixel tiles. Overworld characters are 16x32 pixels per frame. Every pixel must align to the grid; no half pixels, no sub-pixel detail.
Pixels: crisp hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients; deliberate 2-tone checker dithering only on large surfaces or for fake transparency. 1px dark outline in deep blue-grey (around #1a1c2c, not pure black) on characters, props and icons; terrain tiles have no outline.
Palette: limited muted palette of max 32 colors, matching the existing game sprites. Desaturated slate blues, fog greys, soot browns, mossy greens, rust and brass, bone white; warm amber/yellow only for gas lamp light and candles; turquoise #6fe0d0 or deep violet reserved for occult/supernatural things. Avoid saturated primaries and pure black/white.
Lighting: flat base colors with 2-3 shade steps; light from top-left. Do not bake night darkness into sprites (the engine adds lighting).
Mood: melancholic, mysterious, slightly unsettling, never gory.
Output: transparent background (PNG with alpha) unless stated otherwise, orthographic, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no signature.
Avoid: 3D render look, painterly style, photorealism, chibi exaggeration, anime eyes, references to existing games, films or franchises.

Setting: an original foggy Victorian-era industrial city called Kettlegate with occult undertones: cobblestone streets, gas lamps, soot-stained brick, wrought iron, canals, chapels, secret societies, alchemical potions.
Grid: strict 16x16 pixel tiles. Overworld characters are 16x32 pixels per frame. Every pixel must align to the grid; no half pixels, no sub-pixel detail.
Pixels: crisp hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients; deliberate 2-tone checker dithering only on large surfaces or for fake transparency. 1px dark outline in deep blue-grey (around #1a1c2c, not pure black) on characters, props and icons; terrain tiles have no outline.
Palette: limited muted palette of max 32 colors, matching the existing game sprites. Desaturated slate blues, fog greys, soot browns, mossy greens, rust and brass, bone white; warm amber/yellow only for gas lamp light and candles; turquoise #6fe0d0 or deep violet reserved for occult/supernatural things. Avoid saturated primaries and pure black/white.
Lighting: flat base colors with 2-3 shade steps; light from top-left. Do not bake night darkness into sprites (the engine adds lighting).
Mood: melancholic, mysterious, slightly unsettling, never gory.
Output: transparent background (PNG with alpha) unless stated otherwise, orthographic, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no signature.
Avoid: 3D render look, painterly style, photorealism, chibi exaggeration, anime eyes, references to existing games, films or franchises.
Portrait sheet of a heavyset desk sergeant in a police-blue uniform with rolled sleeves, ink-stained fingers, reading glasses on a cord, grey moustache. Four equal 64x64 bust portraits in a single horizontal row: neutral, skeptical raised eyebrow, approving slight nod, angry furrowed brow. Facing slightly right, consistent framing, opaque dark slate background.
Use attached sprites as strict style reference: same palette, outline color, pixel density, proportions and light direction. Output exact uniformly spaced cell layout, no outside margins, no labels, no grid lines. Logical canvas 256x64 pixels; integer enlargement allowed.

Setting: an original foggy Victorian-era industrial city called Kettlegate with occult undertones: cobblestone streets, gas lamps, soot-stained brick, wrought iron, canals, chapels, secret societies, alchemical potions.
Grid: strict 16x16 pixel tiles. Overworld characters are 16x32 pixels per frame. Every pixel must align to the grid; no half pixels, no sub-pixel detail.
Pixels: crisp hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients; deliberate 2-tone checker dithering only on large surfaces or for fake transparency. 1px dark outline in deep blue-grey (around #1a1c2c, not pure black) on characters, props and icons; terrain tiles have no outline.
Palette: limited muted palette of max 32 colors, matching the existing game sprites. Desaturated slate blues, fog greys, soot browns, mossy greens, rust and brass, bone white; warm amber/yellow only for gas lamp light and candles; turquoise #6fe0d0 or deep violet reserved for occult/supernatural things. Avoid saturated primaries and pure black/white.
Lighting: flat base colors with 2-3 shade steps; light from top-left. Do not bake night darkness into sprites (the engine adds lighting).
Mood: melancholic, mysterious, slightly unsettling, never gory.
Output: transparent background (PNG with alpha) unless stated otherwise, orthographic, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no signature.
Avoid: 3D render look, painterly style, photorealism, chibi exaggeration, anime eyes, references to existing games, films or franchises.

Pixels: crisp hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients; deliberate 2-tone checker dithering only on large surfaces or for fake transparency. 1px dark outline in deep blue-grey (around #1a1c2c, not pure black) on characters, props and icons; terrain tiles have no outline.
Palette: limited muted palette of max 32 colors, matching the existing game sprites. Desaturated slate blues, fog greys, soot browns, mossy greens, rust and brass, bone white; warm amber/yellow only for gas lamp light and candles; turquoise #6fe0d0 or deep violet reserved for occult/supernatural things. Avoid saturated primaries and pure black/white.
Lighting: flat base colors with 2-3 shade steps; light from top-left. Do not bake night darkness into sprites (the engine adds lighting).
Mood: melancholic, mysterious, slightly unsettling, never gory.
Output: transparent background (PNG with alpha) unless stated otherwise, orthographic, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no signature.
Avoid: 3D render look, painterly style, photorealism, chibi exaggeration, anime eyes, references to existing games, films or franchises.
Character: an eccentric astronomer with wild white hair, a star-patterned scarf, many lenses on chains around his neck, ink on his nose. 4 rows down,left,right,up and 4 walk frames per row. Each cell 16x32.
Use attached sprites as strict style reference: same palette, outline color, pixel density, proportions and light direction. Output exact uniformly spaced cell layout, no outside margins, no labels, no grid lines. Logical canvas 64x128 pixels; integer enlargement allowed.
